hook: Math's most admired equation, hung on a garden fence.
hookText: Euler's identity on a garden fence

beats.say: In 2016, Austrian artist Aldo Tolino cut e to the i pi equals minus one out of wood and hung it on a rusty chain-link fence between two gardens.
Euler's identity is usually written e to the i pi plus one equals zero, putting five famous constants in one line.
Geometrically, it's half a turn around the unit circle. The piece survives as three photographs, each about 80 by 100 centimetres.
